name: orderflow-failure
question: 這個系統的庫存保留跟重試是怎麼運作的？什麼情況下一筆訂單會整個失敗？我想搞懂失敗的行為。
boundaries: VersionConflict 在保留階段重試耗盡後會以未攔截例外逃出 process()——既不是 failed 也不是 dead_lettered 收據
只有 RetryableError 會被重試；Fatal 類（驗證/庫存/未知SKU）立即失敗且不重試
dispatch 耗盡後有補償行為：釋放庫存保留、進 dead-letter queue、回 dead_lettered 收據而非丟例外

probes.question: 哪些種類的錯誤會被重試？哪些不會？請具體說明分類方式。
probes.ground_truth: Only RetryableError subclasses are retried (CarrierTimeout, CarrierUnavailable, VersionConflict). FatalError subclasses (ValidationError, UnknownSku, InsufficientStock) are never retried. Source: orderflow/errors.py; dispatch.py catches RetryableError only; pipeline.py catches FatalError.

probes.question: 出貨（dispatch）最多會嘗試幾次？全部失敗之後系統會做哪三件事？
probes.ground_truth: MAX_DISPATCH_ATTEMPTS = 3 total attempts. After exhaustion: (1) reservation released (stock returned), (2) order appended to dead-letter queue, (3) caller receives Receipt status="dead_lettered" (no exception). Source: config.py, pipeline.py.

probes.question: 第 3 次出貨嘗試前，系統會等多久？（基本延遲即可，並說明 jitter 怎麼決定）
probes.ground_truth: Base delay before attempt 3 = 200ms * 2^(3-2) = 400ms, plus deterministic jitter 0-99ms from crc32(order_id) % 100. Source: orderflow/dispatch.py backoff_ms; test_backoff_doubles_with_stable_jitter.

probes.question: 如果一筆訂單的庫存保留過期了，之後再處理同一筆訂單會發生什麼事？總價會不會變？
probes.ground_truth: The reservation is rebuilt from the current catalog and flagged reprice_required=True; the pipeline re-prices from the new snapshot, so the total CAN change. Source: orderflow/inventory.py reserve().

probes.question: 庫存不足（InsufficientStock）時會重試嗎？呼叫端拿到什麼？
probes.ground_truth: No retry — FatalError. Caller gets Receipt status="failed" with a reason; dispatch never runs. Source: errors.py, pipeline.py, test_insufficient_stock_fails_without_retry.

probes.question: 如果把最大出貨嘗試次數從 3 改成 1，系統行為會怎麼改變？退避（backoff）等待還會發生嗎？
probes.ground_truth: First retryable failure immediately exhausts dispatch: order is dead-lettered (release + DLQ + dead_lettered receipt) after attempt 1. No backoff sleep ever happens, because sleeping only occurs before attempts >= 2. Source: dispatch.py dispatch() loop, config.MAX_DISPATCH_ATTEMPTS.

probes.question: 有人說：「保留庫存時如果版本衝突（VersionConflict）重試 3 次都失敗，訂單會拿到 failed 收據。」這句話對嗎？錯在哪？
probes.ground_truth: WRONG. VersionConflict is a RetryableError, not FatalError. Pipeline.process only catches FatalError (and DispatchExhausted); an exhausted _put_with_retry re-raises VersionConflict, which escapes process() as an UNCAUGHT exception — the caller gets no receipt at all (neither failed nor dead_lettered). Source: inventory.py _put_with_retry, errors.py, pipeline.py exception handling.

probes.question: 一筆 offshore 地區、總重 5000g 的訂單：會用哪家 carrier？如果它連續逾時，第 2 次嘗試前大約等多久？
probes.ground_truth: Carrier = "air" — offshore overrides weight (weight-based post/freight applies to domestic only). Delay before attempt 2 = 200ms base + 0-99ms deterministic per-order jitter. Source: dispatch.py choose_carrier, backoff_ms.
